AFTERMATH NG SUNOG SA QC

Halos maabo ang ilang bahay matapos ang sunog na sumiklab sa isang residential area sa NIA Road sa Barangay Pinyahan sa Quezon City nitong Biyernes ng gabi, March 6.

Umabot sa Task Force Bravo ang sunog na tumagal nang walong oras. Nakontrol naman ang sunog madaling araw ngayong Sabado, March 7.

Pito ang napaulat na sugatan sa insidente.

Patuloy rin ang imbestigasyon sa sanhi at pinagmulan ng sunog.

📸:  Persida Rueda-Acosta

🗞 Important news by Saturday morning, March 7:

🟢 Over the past night, 124 Ukrainian UAVs were shot down over Russian regions, including one flying towards Moscow, according to the Ministry of Defense. The drones were shot down over the Bryansk, Oryol, Belgorod, Ryazan, Kaluga, Voronezh, Kursk, Rostov, Volgograd, Tula, Samara, Lipetsk, Saratov, Ulyanovsk, and Ivanovo regions, Crimea, as well as the Moscow region.

🟢 Russian companies will soon redirect a portion of their LNG supplies from Europe to friendly countries, without waiting for further restrictions from the EU, said Russian Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak. According to him, the list of countries will include China, India, Thailand, and the Philippines.

🟢 Kirill Dmitriev reported that he is discussing the issue of easing sanctions on Russian oil with the United States amid the conflict in the Middle East. Western restrictions have proven that they harm the global economy, emphasized the special representative of the President of the Russian Federation.

🟢 US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said that Washington may continue to lift restrictions on Russian oil. The White House is considering this possibility due to the shortage of raw materials on the global market, he said.

🟢 The US has intelligence indicating that China may be preparing to provide financial assistance to Iran, as well as supply spare parts and missile components, CNN reports, citing sources.

🟢 Four Iranian UAVs were shot down over Jordanian territory, Al Jazeera reported.

🟢 Qatar has allowed flights into its airports for seven hours, subject to prior arrangement. This was reported by air traffic control services.

🟢 The conflict around Iran has provoked a gas shortage in Transnistria, local media report.

🟢 The Philippines is switching to a four-day work week due to the escalation of the conflict in the Middle East. As Bloomberg notes, the measures were taken due to the rise in global fuel prices due to tensions in the Middle East region. The four-day week is temporary and applies to government agencies. It will not affect those who provide emergency services to the population, including the police, firefighters, and other departments.

🟢 The capitalization of American public companies decreased by almost a trillion dollars on the last day of the first working week of spring.
- FRWL

AFTERMATH NG SUNOG SA BRGY. PINYAHAN, QUEZON CITY

PANOORIN: Pinsalang iniwan ng sunog na sumiklab sa Barangay Pinyahan, Quezon City kagabi, March 6.

Ayon sa Quezon CIty Government, hindi bababa sa 970 pamilya ang pansamantalang nananatili sa iba’t ibang evacuation center dahil sa sunog na umabot sa ikalimang alarma.

Pito ang naitalang nasugatan sa insidente.

COURTESY: Quezon City Government

profile_bio.description: Welcome to the official X account of GMA News.

data.text:
Hindi bababa sa 970 na pamilya ang pansamantalang nananatili sa iba-ibang evacuation center matapos ang sunog sa isang residential area sa NIA Road, Barangay Pinyahan kahapon. 

Umabot sa “Task Force Bravo” ang sunog at 7 ang naitalang nasugatan. 

Tulong-tulong ang QC Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office, QC Fire Department, Social Services Development Department, Traffic & Transport Management Department, Department of Public Order & Safety, City Veterinary Department, QC Health Department, QC Police District, at barangay officials sa pag-agapay sa mga nasunugan.

Kasalukuyang nanunuluyan ang mga apektadong residente sa mga sumusunod na evacuation centers:

1. Pinyahan Covered Court
2. Flora Ylagan  High School
3. San Isidro Labrador Church
4. Pinyahan Elementary School
5. NIA Building
6. NIA Covered Court
7. NAPOCOR
8. Seedling NHA
9. Post Office

Patuloy rin ang pamahalaang lungsod sa pag-alalay sa iba pang pangangailangan ng mga evacuees.

data.text:
Patuloy ang pagtugon ng iba-ibang ahensya kasunod ng sunog sa NIA Road, Quezon City. 

Nagsasagawa na ng clean-up ang   DSQC, habang nanguna naman ang QC Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (QCDRRMO) at District Action Office sa pag-set up ng mga modular tent sa mga evacuation site.

Kasabay nito, nagtayo ang Quezon City Health Department (QCHD) ng medical post upang tugunan ang mga pangangailangang medikal ng mga apektadong residente, kabilang ang paggamot sa mga nagtamo ng sugat, check-up, libreng gamot, at pagbabakuna para sa mga pansamantalang nanunuluyan sa evacuation sites.
